newsitem.title: UK: Ford Motor Credit plans $1.0 bln 5-year bond soon.
newsitem.headline: Ford Motor Credit plans $1.0 bln 5-year bond soon.

text.p: Ford Motor Credit Co will launch a $1.0 billion five-year global bond in the near future, syndicate managers said on Monday.
Goldman Sachs was tipped as lead manager of the deal.
Dealers said the launch spread was likely to be between 45 and 50 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
FMCC issued a $750 million five-year Euro-Asian bond in May via Lehman Brothers and Merrill Lynch at a spread of 46 b.p. over Treasuries.
Last October, FMCC issued a $1.0 billion five-year global bond via Goldman Sachs at 53 b.p. over Treasury notes.
